snippet.title: Kernelbay: A cozy fishing game that lives on your desktop.
snippet.description:
Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3686480/Kernelbay/

More than an idle game, Kernelbay is a calm journey across mysterious islands 🌊

Start from a small dock and slowly expand your fishing life: unlock licenses, upgrade your gear, and discover new species 🎣
Each island is a handcrafted world with its own creatures, story, music, and even its own desktop wallpaper
There’s no rush... just a quiet, evolving loop that lives alongside your day, always progressing, never intrusive
